points: Central brown naevus with a round or oval white ring; over months the centre fades and may disappear.
The white area later repigments in many.

items.t: Atypical central lesion or new halo in an adult: **suspected cancer pathway**.

pearls.t: Halo naevi are benign in children; the halo is a sign of immune clearance, not of cancer.
